schema.text: Descriptive title, blank line, independently authored declarative prose
schema.source: Authored-source attribution, not an external dataset claim

author: Codex, im Auftrag des FreqAI-Projekts
creation_method: Original assistant-authored declarative information; not a repackaging of previous response examples

editorial_review.content: Descriptions of the project assistant, conversation concepts, feelings, wishes, activities and German grammatical forms
editorial_review.speech_act_lexicon: Membership facts such as a word being a greeting word are lexical descriptions, not conditional answer-selection rules
excluded: old answer texts reused as prose
invented human feelings or personal biography for the assistant
editorial_review.limitation: Editorial review records intent and content assessment; structural tests cannot prove absence of every possible disguised semantic rule.

tests.scope: Schema, absence of QA/turn fields, unique content, complete prose structure, transparent authorship and hashes; limited rule lint

note: These basic authored definitions are a small information source. They do not establish that a decoder can conduct arbitrary everyday conversations or that every capability is supported in its current implementation.
